title: Password Maker
mechanic: Sets, sampling and a word list

scenario.title: A passphrase is only as good as its word list
scenario.body: Gluing random words together makes passwords people can remember. But the program is only as good as the list it picks from: with three words and four needed, or settings that filter every word out, the book's version crashes. A password maker should explain the problem, and never hand out a password with fewer words than you asked for.

note: The book's word list is the 235,886-word dictionary from a Mac (/usr/share/dict/words), about 2.5 MB. The tests need that exact list to get the same passwords from the same seed, so this chapter takes a moment longer to load.

character.name: Shh
character.role: a snail who makes secret passwords

tagline: Shh picks random words and glues them into a secret password you can remember, like MoonPicklePonySock. Use your own words or the big dictionary. (For real accounts, ask a grown-up about a password manager.)

brain_blurbs.book: Picks words from the list and glues them together.
brain_blurbs.real: Also tells you when the list is too short to pick from.

rules.test_exists: Shh and the big word list are here
rules.test_usage: Explains itself when you ask for help
rules.test_bad_file: Says so when the word list doesn't exist
rules.test_bad_num: "How many passwords" has to be a whole number
rules.test_bad_num_words: "How many words" has to be a whole number
rules.test_bad_min_word_len: "Shortest word" has to be a whole number
rules.test_bad_max_word_len: "Longest word" has to be a whole number
rules.test_bad_seed: The lucky number has to be a whole number
rules.test_defaults: Lucky number 1 makes exactly the book's three passwords
rules.test_num_words: Can use two words instead of four
rules.test_min_word_len: Can skip words shorter than 5 letters
rules.test_max_word_len: Can allow words up to 10 letters
rules.test_l33t: Secret-code mode swaps letters for look-alikes (a → @, S → 5) and adds a squiggle
rules.test_clean: Strips out everything that isn't a letter
rules.test_ransom: Flips a coin for every letter: BIG or small
rules.test_l33t_adds_one_mark: Secret-code mode always adds exactly one punctuation mark
rules.test_too_few_words_is_a_clear_error: Only 3 words but 4 needed? Shh explains instead of crashing
rules.test_every_word_filtered_out: No words of the right length? Shh says so
rules.test_min_bigger_than_max: "Shortest 8, longest 4" can't work, and Shh says why
rules.test_zero_words_is_refused: A password with zero words would be empty: no thanks
rules.test_same_word_counted_once: "Cat cat CAT" is just one word
rules.test_no_word_twice_in_a_password: Never uses the same word twice in one password
rules.test_several_files_share_one_list: Words from two lists go into one big list
rules.test_clean_keeps_only_letters: Any word at all: only its letters are kept
rules.test_ransom_only_changes_case: Coin flips only change BIG and small, never the letters
rules.test_passwords_use_different_words_from_: Any list: each password uses the right number of different words from it
